req.title: Reject duplicate playerId on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with an ID that already exists.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-007 requires HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with a squad_number that already exists. The route checks retrieve_by_squad_number_async and raises HTTPException(409) on a hit. Tests must cover: (1) positive path — a genuinely new squad_number succeeds with 201; (2) negative path — a duplicate squad_number returns exactly 409; (3) boundary — the squad_number immediately adjacent to an existing one (27, one above the highest seeded value 26) succeeds with 201, confirming the uniqueness check is on squad_number identity not range; (4) state-transition — first POST succeeds (201), second POST with same squad_number returns 409, confirming idempotent rejection; (5) decision-table — a payload that differs in every field except squad_number still triggers 409, proving the conflict key is squad_number alone.

tests.name: test_post_new_player_returns_201
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows (squad numbers 1-26)
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains the created player with squad_number=99
Response body contains a valid UUID id field
trace: R-PLAYER-007: positive path — new squad_number must succeed
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import json

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_new_player_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None

test_post_new_player_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_then_unique_state_transition
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with squad number 1 (Anjali Banerjee)
trace: R-PLAYER-007: STC — system transitions from conflict state to created state when squad_number changes
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_duplicate_then_unique_state_transition():
    dup_payload = {
        "firstName": "Anjali",
        "lastName": "Banerjee",
        "squadNumber": 1,
        "position": "Defensive Midfield"
    }
    r1 = client.post("/players/", json=dup_payload)
    assert r1.status_code == 409
    assert r1.json()["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

    new_payload = {
        "firstName": "New",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r2 = client.post("/players/", json=new_payload)
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    assert r2.json()["squadNumber"] == 50

test_post_duplicate_then_unique_state_transition()

tests.name: test_post_conflict_key_is_squad_number_not_other_fields
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with squad number 5 (Vivaan Nair)
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=5 but completely different firstName, lastName, position
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict — conflict is keyed on squad_number alone, not other fields
Response detail is exactly 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
trace: R-PLAYER-007: DT — conflict detection uses squad_number as the sole discriminator

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_response_has_no_extra_fields
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with squad number 26 (Aditya Mehta)
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=26 (duplicate of highest seeded value)
expected: Response JSON has key 'detail' with exact conflict message
trace: R-PLAYER-007: NEG + EP — upper boundary duplicate must return 409 with correct detail
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_duplicate_response_has_no_extra_fields():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Aditya",
        "lastName": "Mehta",
        "squadNumber": 26,
        "position": "Defensive Midfield"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 409
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 422
    assert r.status_code != 500
    body = r.json()
    assert body["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

test_post_duplicate_response_has_no_extra_fields()
